# Proto-Avali
Being a Protogen comes easy to Avali, as they already live in a culture of extensive cybernetic modifcation. The prime example being the [color=#ffbc48]Nexus[/color] which is a Augmented Reality (AR) implant every individual recives in their society.
## Racial Features - They are no longer obligate carnivores and are now able to eat most normal foods. - They get hungry [color=#ffa500]100% faster[/color]. - Their blood is ammonia-based and has a distinct purple color, it is metabolised from copper and it has a [color=#ffa500]severe allergic reaction to iron[/color]. - They requires a special chemical, Amoxla, to heal airloss damage. - Regular [color=#ffa500]airloss chemicals are extremely deadly[/color] to them. - Their wings give them [color=#1e90ff]60% more acceleration in 0 gravity[/color]. - They are quick and nimble, [color=#1e90ff]running 6% faster[/color]. - They are slightly more frail, [color=#ffa500]falling into crit at 90 damage and dying at 180 damage[/color]. - They receive [color=#ffa500]20% more heat damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]70% less cold damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1e90ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - They posses [color=#ffbc48]nanite Technology![/color] Can encase themselves in a [color=#ffbc48]Nanite Shell[/color] to heal most common types of damage. - They can talk over [color=#ffbc48]The Nexus with :x[/color]. - Thanks to their claws they deal [color=red]6.25[/color] slash damage with their unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is -10 degrees Celcius and they [color=#1e90ff]can withstand temperatures between -50 and 40 degrees Celcius[/color].
## Weapon Knockback Avali are incredibly lightweight, and thus they have difficulty using weapons that are any bigger than pistols or SMGs. Shooting any other weapon will cause them to take stamina damage and get pushed back. Rocket launchers, since they are recoil-less, will actually [color=red]pull Avali forward with the rocket[/color] for a short distance. Stamina resistance will help mitigate some of the effects of knockback, but will never completely negate it.
## Scratch and Trinary The Avali language, known as Scratch, is composed of a series of screeches, caws and throat sounds. It is often described as fast paced and sharp, easily pronounceable by most species with some practice. In addition, Avali share this language with Resomi. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Avali are a long lived species, reaching adulthood around 18 years of age and being capable of living for 300 years. Their names are given to them upon hatching, often consisting of a first name, followed by a pack name.
